Task: Hover the mouse cursor over an interactive (i.e., not yet correctly grouped) word tile.
Expected Result: The tile under the cursor displays a subtle glow effect. The glow effect is removed when the mouse cursor moves away from the tile.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
expected: The tile under the cursor displays a subtle glow effect. The glow effect is removed when the mouse cursor moves away from the tile.
